monthly_covariates.rule: value for month m is usable from origin m+1 (a forecast made at the end of month m cannot see month m's monthly aggregate)

charging_stations.rule: release month stored per snapshot in data/external/charging_snapshots.csv (ministry/parliament replies: label+1); never back-filled; earlier origins see NaN

nsdp_per_capita.rule: financial-year value is usable 24 months after the FY starts (FY2022-23 from Apr-2024); the Projected FY2026-27 figure is therefore never visible inside the data window; origins earlier see NaN

feature_sets.F2: F1 + release-aligned charging stations and NSDP
